items.headline: Oregon's mascot trolls USC with Trojan horse pregame entrance
items.description: The Oregon Duck evidently spent its bye week toiling on a woodworking project.

items.headline: Ducks' Raiola benched as Lanning vows to review whole offense
items.description: Dylan Raiola looked nothing like the quarterback who led Oregon to victory over USC last week, going 6-for-19 for 43 yards with three turnovers, prompting coach Dan Lanning to say, "We didn't prepare him to be good enough today."

items.headline: No. 21 UCLA downs turnover-plagued No. 13 Oregon 17-15 to remain undefeated
items.description: — Wayne Knight rushed for a touchdown and caught another score, and No. 21 UCLA overcame an injury to starting quarterback Nico Iamaleava to remain undefeated with a 17-15 victory over No. 13 Oregon on Saturday.
